subject: Data description entry
notes: 'the only other clauses permitted are level-number, entry-name, PICTURE, USAGE, and VALUE' - a whole-list rule implemented as a ten-flag || chain that could not see ALIGNED, CONSTANT RECORD, DYNAMIC LENGTH, GLOBAL, GROUP-USAGE, PROPERTY, SAME AS, SELECT WHEN or the validation clauses, nine of the fourteen it excludes. Now the WRITTEN clause set against LengthClauseCoPermitted OR the subject's own bit; the co-permitted constant excludes BOTH length clauses, which is what makes ANY LENGTH DYNAMIC LENGTH on one entry a violation of both rules rather than neither. kb/Work PB487.
